name: step-form
title: Step Form
description: Multi-step form with validation per step.

files.content:
export { StepForm } from './StepForm'
export type { StepFormStep, StepFormProps } from './step-form.types'

import type React from 'react'

export interface StepFormStep {
  id: string
  title: string
  description?: string
  content: React.ReactNode
  validate?: () => boolean | string
}

export interface StepFormProps {
  steps: StepFormStep[]
  onComplete?: (stepId: string) => void
  className?: string
  style?: React.CSSProperties
}
